title: John Harbaugh: Sunday was a pivotal game, our guys took the bull by the horns

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh: Sunday was a pivotal game, our guys took the bull by the horns
sources.description: The Giants came into Sunday's game in Houston off a tie and a loss that led to a quarterback change and oddsmakers installed them as heavy underdogs as a result.
